en: ...So you're the next one. The latest Trainer come to take on Sunyshore's Gym.
text: ...Deci tu urmezi. Ultimul Antrenor venit să provoace Arena din Sunyshore.

en: All right. I've made up my mind. If you turn out to be weak, I'm leaving, to challenge the Pokémon League myself.
text: Bine. M-am hotărât. Dacă nu ești la înălțime, plec, să provoc eu însumi Liga Pokémon.

en: The Gym is rebuilt, down to the last gear. Nothing keeps me here any more. What I want is a battle that makes my heart race again.
text: Arena e refăcută, până la ultimul angrenaj. Nu mă mai ține nimic aici. Ce vreau e o luptă care să-mi facă inima să bată iar tare.

en: They call me the strongest Gym Leader in Sinnoh. So everything I have, I'm throwing at you.
text: Mi se spune cel mai puternic Lider de Arenă din Sinnoh. Așa că arunc spre tine tot ce am.

en: Up here the wind comes straight off the sea. It's the closest thing in Sinnoh to the open sky.
Where I come from we battle in the air: a Sky Battle. Only Pokémon that fly or float can take part.
And no move that needs the ground. No Earthquake, no Dig, nothing that slams a foe down onto anything.
My team has rested and the wind is right. Will you take to the sky with me?
Then up we go! Keep your eyes on the horizon!
What a flight! You and your Pokémon read the wind as if you'd been born to it.
One Sky Battle a day is all my team can manage. Come and fly with me again tomorrow.
The sky is a hard place to learn in. Watch how the wind carries them, and try again tomorrow.
None of your Pokémon can fly or float, I'm afraid. Bring one that can, and we'll take to the sky.
Not today? The wind will still be here. So will I.
My team is resting their wings. One Sky Battle a day! Come back tomorrow.
Far to the north, across the sea, a wall of rock climbs out of the water, with a waterfall white down its face.
text: Departe, spre nord, peste mare, un zid de stâncă se ridică din apă, cu o cascadă albă pe fața lui.

en: And on top of it, half lost in cloud, stand the towers of the Pokémon League.
text: Iar în vârful lui, pe jumătate pierdute în nori, stau turnurile Ligii Pokémon.
